answer: The beacon schedule is applied in saffron and lagoon exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 613 identities would post 1540 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
